author: jamezy22
quote: Ive now played for 10 hours and its 90% doing chores for Lucia. The other 10% includes pittiful story writing, drive here, go there, come here, etc. The missions/characters as well as the writing are all quite dissapointing. Secondly, the 30 fps target is abysmal and in a lot of scenarios it drops down to 15fps which is unacceptable.
